g.text: Type what you want done / commands @ files ! shell ? help
Find, open, rename, fork, export, archive or delete threads
Pick the agent: Build, Plan, Delegate, Red Team or yours
Approvals: ask first, full access or read only
Add a provider: sign in or paste a key
Set the thread's goal; the agent keeps working until it is achieved
See and edit the to-do list
See and edit what the agent knows about this project
